title: I Was Scrolling and Then I Saw a Pregnant Strawberry

bias_targets.methodology: Manual annotation of 137 AI-generated videos to analyze character roles and plot structures, comparing the frequency of negative depictions (73.7% for females vs. 33.6% for males) and categorizing 22 specific negative representation types across 6 macro-areas.

Qualitative analysis using critical race theory to evaluate the 'logic of racialization' and colorism in narratives where physical differences (e.g., fruit species or color) signify moral failings, cheating, or social hierarchy.

Evaluation of narrative tropes where characters are ranked by their 'market value' as a proxy for social worth and observations of characters engaging in species-based 'passing' to access higher social status.
